payment_provider_contract.description: The identifier of payment provider contract you want to process the transaction request with.

brand_choice.description: For dual-branded cards identifies whether selection is made by a cardholder or merchant.

amount.description: Amount is charged without a decimal place e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials, see Currencies Section for more details. For Account Verification transactions, provide 0 as value for this field.

shopper_interaction.title: Ecommerce Shopper Interaction
shopper_interaction.description:
Determines the sales channel the shopper gives their card details through:
  * `ECOMMERCE` Online transactions where the cardholder is present.
  * `MAIL` order transactions where the shopper is in contact with the merchant via email.
  * `TELEPHONE` order transactions where the shopper is in contact with the merchant via telephone.

merchant_reference.description: A reference specified by the merchant to identify the transaction.

line_items.description: The array of items being refunded.

receipt_type.description: Defines the type of receipt to be generated

tax_indicator.title: Tax Indicator
tax_indicator.description: This field indicates the taxable status of the transaction (if any of the purchased items are taxable). This field is part of so-called Level 2 data. If the value `TAX_PROVIDED` is sent, `tax_amount` should also be provided

purchase_order_number.title: Purchase Order Number
purchase_order_number.description: The purchase order number. It can be provided in transactions with purchase or procurement cards for the cardholder to get better interchange rates (note that this functionality needs alignment with the acquirer and the scheme). This field is part of so-called Level 2 data.

promo_code.description: A code defined by the merchant that affects the calculation of the total amount.
